final class Entry {
    static String entry(String payload) {
        return Service.relay(payload);
    }

    static String operationEntry(String operationPayload) {
        Service.relay(operationPayload);
        return "handled";
    }

    static String unrelated(String unrelatedPayload) {
        return "unchanged";
    }

    static String overwritten(String obsolete, String replacement) {
        String value = obsolete;
        value = replacement;
        return value;
    }

    static String callback(Object unusedContext) {
        return "callback contract";
    }

    static String preserveEffect(Runnable effect) {
        effect.run();
        return "initializer must remain";
    }
}
